assessment: Exact original sender/nonce/hash is pinned at production admission. Ethers signature/raw decoding binds chain11155111/type2/self/value0/data0x/empty accessList/21000 and unchanged fees capped at5gwei. No signing port is used by the exact-dispatch runner.

An exclusive fsynced entered sidecar precedes dispatch. All entered outcomes, including failed fsync acknowledgement, post-entry veto, transport error, wrong acknowledgement and observation persistence failure remain reconcile-only. Changing expiry cannot create another slot.

Original state.lock plus lead-owned sender lease remains the operational serialization boundary. Three candidate receipts/effects are reconciled before entry and again before dispatch; visible/pending candidates, changed nonce, stale canonical head, insufficient balance or unaffordable original fee stop the operation.

The raw RPC path makes one bounded10s nonredirecting request without retry or auxiliary broadcastTransaction metadata calls. A returned transport acknowledgement does not establish canonical execution; existing three-winner reconciliation remains decisive.
The change reuses existing plan/signature/reconciliation/lock/transport machinery and adds one bounded explicit recovery transition; no scheduler, key capability or general replacement framework.
limitations: Original429 observation is not proof the earlier raw transaction was unaccepted: the old ethers broadcast path also ran auxiliary RPCs. This recovery relies on explicit authority and exact signed transaction idempotency, not absence or429 alone.

Local expiry does not expire signed bytes on chain. A later winner can still race fresh observations; exact nonce/hash prevents a different new transaction, and final canonical winner reconciliation remains required.
The trusted original directory, sidecar retention and exclusive lead sender lease must remain intact; deleting the permanent sidecar or bypassing the trusted operator is outside this mechanism.

No real network outcome, fee expenditure, deployment, continuation, or broader testnet release acceptance is claimed. Worker101 affected passes are reported by its packet; reviewer independently ran only the8 targeted cases.
